vehicle.notes: UK RHD. Mercedes LH/RH (left/right) = vehicle's own left/right: LH = UK nearside (passenger side), RH = UK offside (driver side). Facelift from 2018. Numbers were read from web-search result titles, URLs and extracts of the cited pages; page fetches were blocked (globalparts.co.uk is not allowed by this session's network). globalparts.co.uk marks right-hand-drive stock with 'RHD' in the listing URL: those entries are market UK; its unmarked listings are market unknown (may come from LHD cars). globalparts and MB Used Parts (usedparts.mercedes-benz.com, Mercedes-Benz's own used-parts shop in Germany, market EU-LHD) sell used parts, so no prices were recorded; no new-part UK price was seen. Bumpers, headlamps, mirrors and cooling parts depend on trim (AMG Line / Sport / SE), PTS parking sensors, lamp type, mirror equipment and engine, so they are marked variant and not auto-filled. Research stopped early because the shared web-search budget ran out. Verify every number by VIN/datacard.
